articles.summary: Appointment strengthens leadership team as iXCells focuses on expanding its portfolio of custom-tailored iPSC products and delivery of enhanced preclinical services
articles.title: iXCells Biotechnologies Appoints Steve Smith as Chief Executive Officer

articles.summary: iXCells Biotechnologies and Rosebud Biosciences announce a partnership to integrate iPSC and organoid technologies, expanding human-relevant models for drug safety, toxicity, and rare disease research.
articles.title: iXCells Biotechnologies and Rosebud Biosciences Partner to Advance Organoid-Based Models for Rare Diseases
